title: Comment Generator Panel UI rebuild (Customer View + Upload Section + Admin Panel)

requirements.summary: Rebuild information architecture with a segmented top-level navigation for Customer View, Upload Section, and Admin Panel, with active section highlighted and client-side switching.
acceptanceCriteria: The main navigation shows three primary sections: Customer View, Upload Section, Admin Panel.
Switching sections updates the content area without full page reload.
Active/selected section is visually distinct (pill/segmented control style) and matches the screenshot layout closely on mobile widths.

file_operations.description: Update TanStack Router to use three primary section routes (Customer View, Upload Section, Admin Panel) and ensure navigation between them is SPA-based without full reload.

Create a mobile-first segmented control navigation component rendering the three top-level sections with an active pill highlight (use shadcn-ui Button styles where appropriate). Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.
Replace the current header navigation usage with the new TopSegmentedNav placed at the top-level layout so it appears consistently across sections.
Add global utility classes for segmented navigation styling and active state visuals to match the screenshots (rounded pill, soft borders/shadows, mobile spacing).

requirements.summary: Implement Customer View with Single and Bulk Comment Generator cards that require selecting a Comment List and generating via backend, matching screenshot styling and mobile-first layout.
acceptanceCriteria: Customer View shows a prominent heading and subtitle matching the screenshot’s structure (English text).
Single Comment Generator: user must select a comment list; clicking generate returns one comment and marks it as used for that user/device identity (see backend requirements).
Bulk Comment Generator: user must select a comment list and enter number of comments; clicking generate returns that many available comments (or as many as available) and marks them used.
UI components (cards, inputs, buttons) visually follow the screenshot style: rounded containers, soft shadows, and a blue→teal gradient primary button.

file_operations.description: Build the Customer View screen with heading/subtitle plus two cards (Single Comment Generator and Bulk Comment Generator) that: (a) fetch available comment lists, (b) require list selection, (c) call backend functions to generate results, and (d) show generated output with copy actions; use shadcn-ui Card/Input/Select/Button patterns as available. Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.
Add React Query hooks to load available comment lists and perform single/bulk generation using the existing actor from useActor; centralize loading/error states for Customer View.
Add shared UI utilities for screenshot-like cards and primary gradient buttons (blue→teal) used by Customer View generators.

requirements.summary: Implement Upload Section with an Upload Rating Image card (name + file picker) that uploads image blob and metadata to backend and shows success/reset state.
acceptanceCriteria: Upload Section contains an “Upload Rating Image” card with the two inputs (name + file) and an upload button/action.
Selecting an image and submitting uploads the image blob to the backend and stores the uploader name + timestamp.
After successful upload, the UI shows a success confirmation and clears the form (or resets to initial state).
All user-facing text is English.

file_operations.description: Create the Upload Section screen with a single Upload Rating Image card including name input, image file picker, upload progress/disabled state, and a success confirmation that resets the form after completion. Use the blob-storage ExternalBlob API to convert selected files to ExternalBlob for upload and rely on direct URL patterns for previews when needed. Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.
Add React Query mutation hook to upload a rating image (uploaderName + ExternalBlob) and query invalidation hooks used by the Admin Images tab.
Add any Upload Section-specific styling utilities to keep spacing, rounded containers, and gradient CTA consistent with screenshots.

requirements.summary: Implement Admin Panel screen layout with secondary tabs (Comments, Images, Chat, Settings) and keep access gated by existing caffeineAdminToken mechanism without modifying immutable auth hooks.
acceptanceCriteria: Admin Panel route/content is inaccessible without a valid caffeineAdminToken; a clear access denied message is shown otherwise.
Admin Panel shows secondary tabs: Comments, Images, Chat, Settings, with the active tab highlighted similar to the screenshots.
Tab switching changes the visible admin content without leaving the Admin Panel section.
No edits are made to immutable auth hook files; admin gating composes existing logic.

file_operations.description: Create the Admin Panel page with header/subtitle and a secondary tab bar (Comments/Images/Chat/Settings) that switches visible content within the page; wrap admin-only content with the existing AdminTokenGate component (do not change auth hooks). Use shadcn-ui Card/Button where appropriate. Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.
Wire the Admin Panel route into the router and ensure it is guarded by AdminTokenGate so unauthorized users see the existing access denied UI.
Add CSS utilities for Admin Panel secondary tabs (pill-like active highlight and icon/text alignment) to match screenshots.

requirements.summary: Admin Panel Comments tab: implement comment list management UI (create list, select list, manage counts, reset/delete, add comments bulk/single, per-comment delete, totals summary) matching screenshots.
acceptanceCriteria: Admin can create a new list by name; the list appears under Existing Lists immediately after creation.
Admin can select a list to manage and sees a “Managing: <ListName>” header.
Admin can add comments in bulk via textarea (one per line) and via a single-comment input; successful add updates counts and comment list.
Admin can delete individual comments and delete an entire list.
Admin can reset usage (used/available counts) for the selected list (behavior defined in backend).
Admin sees a totals/summary area showing total comments per list (and/or available/used) similar to screenshot structure.
UI closely matches screenshot layout, including pill buttons for bulk/single mode and rounded cards.

file_operations.description: Implement the Admin Comments tab UI: create new list card, existing lists selector/list with lock icons, managing section with available/used counts plus reset/delete controls, bulk/single add modes with pill switch, comment list with per-item delete, and a totals summary card. Use shadcn-ui Card/Input/Textarea/Button components as available. Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.

Add React Query hooks for admin comment management: create/delete lists, load lists, load selected list comments, add single/bulk comments, delete comment, reset list usage, and load totals/summary; ensure queries invalidate appropriately on mutations.
Wire AdminCommentsTab into the Admin Panel secondary tab switching so it renders when the Comments tab is active.
Add CSS utilities for screenshot-like pills, counters/badges (available/used), lock-icon list rows, and rounded card sections used in Comments tab.

requirements.summary: Admin Settings tab: manage Bulk Generator Access Key (status, masked display, reset, set/update with show/hide) and enforce key requirement for Bulk generation on Customer View via backend validation.
acceptanceCriteria: Admin can set/update an access key; backend persists it across reloads/upgrades.
Admin can reset/remove the key.
UI shows masked key when set and an explicit status indicator (set/not set).
Customer Bulk Comment Generator prompts for the access key when required and blocks generation when missing/incorrect.
Access key validation occurs against backend-stored value (not hardcoded in frontend).

file_operations.description: Create Settings tab UI matching screenshots for Bulk Generator Access Key: status chip (Key Set/Not Set), masked key display, reset action, input for new key with show/hide toggle, and Update Key button that calls backend. Use shadcn-ui components where appropriate. Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.
Add React Query hooks to read key status/masked value and perform set/reset operations; expose loading and error states for Settings tab and for Customer View key requirement checks.

Update Bulk Comment Generator card to: (a) check whether a key is required, (b) prompt for access key input when required, and (c) pass the access key to the backend for bulk generation; show clear English error messaging when missing/incorrect.
Wire AdminSettingsTab into the Admin Panel secondary tab switching so it renders when the Settings tab is active.

requirements.summary: Admin Images tab: list uploaded rating images with uploader name, timestamp, thumbnail preview, and delete action, including empty state.
acceptanceCriteria: Admin can see uploaded items with name + timestamp + preview.
Admin can delete an uploaded image; it disappears from the list and is removed from backend storage.
If no images exist, the UI shows a clear empty-state message in English.

file_operations.description: Implement Images tab UI that fetches uploaded rating images, renders a mobile-friendly list/grid with uploader name, formatted timestamp, and image thumbnail using blob-storage ExternalBlob getDirectURL() for previews; support delete actions and an English empty state. Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.
Wire AdminImagesTab into the Admin Panel secondary tab switching so it renders when the Images tab is active.
Extend rating image hooks to include list and delete operations for admin usage (React Query queries + mutations + invalidation).

requirements.summary: Admin Chat tab: implement a simple message composer and ordered message list, persisted via backend, with empty state and consistent styling.
acceptanceCriteria: Admin can add a message (text) and it appears in the message list.
Messages are persisted in backend storage and load on page refresh.
If no messages exist, show an English empty-state message.
UI is mobile-friendly and visually consistent with the Admin Panel cards/tabs.

file_operations.description: Implement Chat tab with message input/composer and ordered message list (formatted timestamps), including an English empty state; use shadcn-ui Card/Input/Textarea/Button patterns as available. Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.
Add React Query hooks to load chat history and add new messages, ensuring refetch/invalidation so the list updates immediately and persists across refresh.
Wire AdminChatTab into the Admin Panel secondary tab switching so it renders when the Chat tab is active.

requirements.summary: Apply consistent screenshot-like visual theme across Customer View, Upload Section, and Admin Panel (pastel background, subtle shapes, rounded cards, gradient primary buttons, mobile-first typography/spacing).
acceptanceCriteria: All three sections share a consistent background and card styling that closely resembles the screenshots.
Primary actions use a blue→teal gradient button treatment with rounded corners.
Typography and spacing are mobile-first and match the screenshot proportions closely.

file_operations.description: Define shared theme utilities (pastel surfaces, rounded card borders/shadows, gradient primary buttons, soft separators, and mobile-first spacing) and apply them via classNames from the new pages/tabs.
Update layout structure to match screenshot spacing (top padding, centered max widths, consistent section containers) and ensure the background/theme is visible behind all cards.
Apply the shared theme styling (cards, headings, gradients, spacing) so Customer View closely matches the screenshots; keep all user-facing text in English.
Apply the shared theme styling (cards, headings, gradients, spacing) so Upload Section closely matches the screenshots; keep all user-facing text in English.
Apply the shared theme styling (cards, headings, gradients, spacing) so Admin Panel closely matches the screenshots; keep all user-facing text in English.

requirements.summary: Add a static generated pastel geometric/confetti background image under frontend/public/assets/generated and render it as the app background.
acceptanceCriteria: A generated background image exists in frontend/public/assets/generated and is referenced by the UI.
The background is visible behind cards and matches the screenshot vibe (pastel, subtle shapes).
No backend endpoints are used to serve the background image.

file_operations.description: Add the required static generated background image asset: frontend/public/assets/generated/admin-bg.dim_1600x900.png.
Render the static background asset as the page backdrop (behind content/cards) using a layout-level background layer so it is not served from the backend.
Add CSS to support background image placement (full-screen cover/contain as appropriate, subtle overlay for readability) while keeping cards readable and screenshot-like.
